summary: Apogee Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to announce positive 16-week induction dose optimization results from Part B of its Phase 2 APEX trial of zumilokibart in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis. The filing discloses clinical data, not a special situation such as an acquisition or restructuring. No deal terms, corporate action, or strategic event is involved; it is a routine clinical-trial update.
